units.source_text: “哪怕不是每天，若答应让龙助到贵店去帮忙，他弟弟真一就会更加好好干，那我就省事了。

en.t: Even if it is not every day, if you would agree to let Ryusuke come help at your shop, his younger brother Shinichi would work even harder, and that would make things easier for me.

units.source_text: 真一是个性情温和的孩子，龙助直到现在还动不动就喊他‘童男’什么的，这是他最讨厌的……因为小时候他坐过祇园节的彩车。”

en.t: Shinichi is a gentle-natured boy, but even now Ryusuke is always calling him things like 'chigo,' which he hates more than anything... because when he was little, he rode on a float in the Gion Festival.
